import bpy,json,math
sc=bpy.context.scene
data=[]
for o in sc.objects:
    if o.type!='MESH': continue
    me=o.data
    verts=[list(o.matrix_world@v.co) for v in me.vertices]
    faces=[list(p.vertices) for p in me.polygons]
    data.append({'name':o.name,'matrix_world':[list(row) for row in o.matrix_world],'world_vertices':verts,'faces':faces,'finite':all(math.isfinite(x) for v in verts for x in v)})
print(json.dumps({'meshes':data,'instances':[{'name':i.object.name,'is_instance':i.is_instance} for i in bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get().object_instances]},ensure_ascii=False))

import bpy,json,math
sc=bpy.context.scene
dg=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
out=[]
for ob in sc.objects:
    if ob.type!='MESH': continue
    eo=ob.evaluated_get(dg)
    me=eo.to_mesh()
    try:
        vv=[[float(x) for x in eo.matrix_world@v.co] for v in me.vertices]
        pp=[list(p.vertices) for p in me.polygons]
        out.append({'name':ob.name,'evaluated_world_vertices':vv,'evaluated_faces':pp,'shape_keys':ob.data.shape_keys is not None,'constraints':len(ob.constraints),'all_coordinates_finite':all(math.isfinite(x) for v in vv for x in v)})
    finally:
        eo.to_mesh_clear()
print(json.dumps({'mesh_count':len(out),'evaluated_geometry':out},ensure_ascii=False))

import bpy, json, math
scene=bpy.context.scene
depsgraph=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
result={'unit_system':scene.unit_settings.system,'scale_length':scene.unit_settings.scale_length,'objects':[]}
for obj in scene.objects:
    if obj.type!='MESH':
        continue
    ev=obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    me=ev.to_mesh()
    try:
        me.calc_loop_triangles()
        mat=ev.matrix_world
        coords=[list(mat @ v.co) for v in me.vertices]
        tris=[list(t.vertices) for t in me.loop_triangles]
        finite=all(math.isfinite(x) for p in coords for x in p)
        result['objects'].append({'name':obj.name,'vertices':coords,'triangles':tris,'finite':finite,'modifiers':[m.type for m in obj.modifiers]})
    finally:
        ev.to_mesh_clear()
print(json.dumps(result,allow_nan=False))
